_comment: Per-state income-tax constants. SOURCE OF TRUTH for both the TypeScript engine (stateTaxRules.ts) and scripts/verify_plan.py — JSON so there is one file and two readers, no hand-duplication. Every constant must be verifiable against the primary source in `sources`. Review annually: see docs/5-state-tax-model.md.

NH.note: The Interest & Dividends Tax was repealed effective 1 Jan 2025 (HB 2, 2023 session), so NH taxes no individual income for TY2026 onward.

TN.note: The Hall income tax on interest and dividends was fully repealed for tax years beginning 1 Jan 2021.

WA.caveat: Washington has no income tax, but levies a 7% excise tax on long-term capital gains above an inflation-indexed standard deduction ($278,000 for 2025), with an additional higher tier. It is NOT modeled here: retirement accounts are exempt, so it reaches only taxable-brokerage gains, and this tool applies a flat cost-basis percentage per withdrawal rather than tracking realized gains.
